svg.title: SmolVLA mixed-storage layout, 32D/18D pathway, and parameter swaps
svg.desc: Frozen 350.17M VLM, 96.61M BF16 expert body stalled in A vs FP32 in B, 3.27M FP32 external and odd-layer cross-attention KV projections with larger relative L2 weight change in A, 18D supervised vs 32D Euler-integrated action path, and wrapping parameter-swap loss results.
